"""Tests for sitegen.parse.parse_page."""

import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from sitegen.parse import parse_page


CONTENT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "content"


def parse_file(name):
    return parse_page((CONTENT_DIR / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


class RealNoteTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_atomic_habits(self):
        page = parse_file("atomic-habits.md")
        self.assertEqual(page["title"], "原子习惯")
        self.assertEqual(page["date"], "2026-10-15")
        self.assertEqual(page["tags"], ["读书", "习惯"])

    def test_deep_work(self):
        page = parse_file("deep-work.md")
        self.assertEqual(page["title"], "深度工作")
        self.assertEqual(page["date"], "2026-09-28")
        self.assertEqual(page["tags"], ["读书", "效率"])

    def test_why_we_sleep(self):
        page = parse_file("why-we-sleep.md")
        self.assertEqual(page["title"], "我们为什么要睡觉")
        self.assertEqual(page["date"], "2026-09-12")
        self.assertEqual(page["tags"], ["读书", "健康"])


class ParsePageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_tags_are_split_and_stripped(self):
        text = "---\ntitle: 标签测试\ndate: 2026-01-02\ntags:  读书 , 效率,习惯  \n---\n正文\n"
        page = parse_page(text)
        self.assertEqual(page["tags"], ["读书", "效率", "习惯"])

    def test_missing_tags_defaults_to_empty_list(self):
        text = "---\ntitle: 无标签\ndate: 2026-01-03\n---\n正文\n"
        page = parse_page(text)
        self.assertEqual(page["tags"], [])

    def test_body_keeps_line_breaks_and_blank_lines(self):
        text = "---\ntitle: 正文测试\ndate: 2026-01-04\ntags: 测试\n---\n第一行\n\n第三行\n"
        page = parse_page(text)
        self.assertEqual(page["body"], "第一行\n\n第三行\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Build the static reading-notes site from content/*.md."""

from pathlib import Path

from sitegen.parse import parse_page
from sitegen.render import index_html, page_html

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CONTENT_DIR = ROOT / "content"
SITE_DIR = ROOT / "site"


def build() -> list[dict]:
    """Parse and render every note, then write the index. Return the pages."""
    SITE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    pages = []
    for source in sorted(CONTENT_DIR.glob("*.md")):
        page = parse_page(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        filename = source.with_suffix(".html").name
        page["url"] = filename
        page["filename"] = filename

        (SITE_DIR / filename).write_text(page_html(page), encoding="utf-8")
        pages.append(page)

    (SITE_DIR / "index.html").write_text(index_html(pages), encoding="utf-8")
    return pages


if __name__ == "__main__":
    built = build()
    print(f"Built {len(built)} notes + index in {SITE_DIR}")

"""Tests for the build pipeline using an isolated temporary directory."""

import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from build import build


class BuildTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_builds_notes_and_index_in_temporary_directory(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
            root = Path(temp_dir)
            content_dir = root / "content"
            site_dir = root / "site"
            content_dir.mkdir()

            (content_dir / "first.md").write_text(
                "---\n"
                "title: 第一篇\n"
                "date: 2026-01-01\n"
                "tags: 测试\n"
                "---\n"
                "\n# 第一篇\n\n正文一。\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            (content_dir / "second.md").write_text(
                "---\n"
                "title: 第二篇\n"
                "date: 2026-02-01\n"
                "---\n"
                "\n# 第二篇\n\n正文二。\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            pages = build(content_dir=content_dir, site_dir=site_dir)

            self.assertEqual(len(pages), 2)
            self.assertTrue((site_dir / "first.html").is_file())
            self.assertTrue((site_dir / "second.html").is_file())
            self.assertTrue((site_dir / "index.html").is_file())

            index = (site_dir / "index.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertIn('href="first.html"', index)
            self.assertIn('href="second.html"', index)
            self.assertLess(index.index("second.html"), index.index("first.html"))

        # TemporaryDirectory has removed its whole tree.
        self.assertFalse(root.exists())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# 读书笔记小站 一个只用 Python 标准库的小型静态站生成器。`content/` 里放 Markdown 读书笔记，构建后输出到 `site/`。 ## 目录 ```text content/ # 笔记源文件 site/ # 构建产物（已被 .gitignore 忽略） sitegen/parse.py # 解析开头 front matter 和正文 sitegen/render.py # 渲染单篇页面和首页 build.py # 构建入口 test_*.py # 单元测试 ``` ## 添加一篇新笔记 在 `content/` 下新建一个 `.md` 文件，文件名会成为输出页面的文件名。例如新建 `content/new-book.md`，构建后得到 `site/new-book.html`。 文件开头用两行 `---` 包住元信息： ```markdown --- title: 书名 date: 2026-10-20 tags: 读书, 效率 --- # 书名 这里开始是正文。 ## 一个要点 - 第一条 - 第二条 相关：[另一篇笔记](other-note.md) ``` - `title`：页面标题，也是首页链接文字。 - `date`：日期，建议使用 `YYYY-MM-DD` 格式；首页按它倒序排列。 - `tags`：可选，用英文逗号分隔。每项会自动去掉两端空格；不写这一行时解析为空列表。 - 第二个 `---` 之后的内容是正文，解析时原样保留。 ## 构建 在项目根目录运行： ```bash python3 build.py ``` 会读取 `content/` 下所有 `.md` 文件，生成对应的 `.html`，并最后生成 `site/index.html`。用浏览器打开 `site/index.html` 即可浏览。 `site/` 是构建产物，不应提交到 git。 ## 支持的 Markdown 语法 当前只支持笔记需要的轻量语法： | 写法 | 效果 | | --- | --- | | `# 标题` | 一级标题 `

` | | `## 标题` | 二级标题 `

` | | 连续的 `- 项目` 行 | 无序列表 `
  • ...
` | | `[文字](note.md)` | 站内链接，输出为 `文字` | | 其他非空行 | 段落 `

arguments.content:
"""Tests for the build pipeline using an isolated temporary directory."""

import contextlib
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
import uuid
from pathlib import Path

from build import build


@contextlib.contextmanager
def temporary_workspace():
    """Yield (content_dir, site_dir, filename_prefix) and clean up after.

    The normal path is a real ``TemporaryDirectory``.  Python's WASI runtime
    cannot remove directories, so there we use the system temporary directory
    directly, give every file a unique prefix, and delete only our own files.
    """
    if sys.platform == "wasi":
        root = Path(tempfile.gettempdir())
        prefix = f"sitegen-test-{uuid.uuid4().hex}-"
        index = root / "index.html"
        previous_index = index.read_bytes() if index.exists() else None
        try:
            yield root, root, prefix
        finally:
            for name in (
                f"{prefix}first.md",
                f"{prefix}second.md",
                f"{prefix}first.html",
                f"{prefix}second.html",
                "index.html",
            ):
                try:
                    (root / name).unlink()
                except FileNotFoundError:
                    pass
            if previous_index is not None:
                index.write_bytes(previous_index)
    else:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sitegen-test-") as temp_dir:
            root = Path(temp_dir)
            content_dir = root / "content"
            content_dir.mkdir()
            yield content_dir, root / "site", ""


class BuildTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_builds_notes_and_index_in_temporary_directory(self):
        with temporary_workspace() as (content_dir, site_dir, prefix):
            first_source = content_dir / f"{prefix}first.md"
            second_source = content_dir / f"{prefix}second.md"
            first_html = site_dir / f"{prefix}first.html"
            second_html = site_dir / f"{prefix}second.html"
            index_html = site_dir / "index.html"

            first_source.write_text(
                "---\n"
                "title: 第一篇\n"
                "date: 2026-01-01\n"
                "tags: 测试\n"
                "---\n"
                "\n# 第一篇\n\n正文一。\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            second_source.write_text(
                "---\n"
                "title: 第二篇\n"
                "date: 2026-02-01\n"
                "---\n"
                "\n# 第二篇\n\n正文二。\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            pages = build(content_dir=content_dir, site_dir=site_dir)

            self.assertEqual(len(pages), 2)
            self.assertTrue(first_html.is_file())
            self.assertTrue(second_html.is_file())
            self.assertTrue(index_html.is_file())

            index = index_html.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertIn(f'href="{prefix}first.html"', index)
            self.assertIn(f'href="{prefix}second.html"', index)
            self.assertLess(
                index.index(f"{prefix}second.html"),
                index.index(f"{prefix}first.html"),
            )

        # Nothing created by this test remains behind.
        self.assertFalse(first_source.exists())
        self.assertFalse(second_source.exists())
        self.assertFalse(first_html.exists())
        self.assertFalse(second_html.exists())
        self.assertFalse(index_html.exists())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
